name: Expression
title: B. Expression
legend: You are given a line «n#m», where «n» and «m» are digits, and «#» is a sign «+» or «-». Print the value of the given expression.
input_spec: The only given line has a string in form «n#m», where «n» and «m» are digits (from 0 to 9), and «#» is a sign «+» or «-».
output_spec: Print the value of the given expression.
